I'm one of the people that's been asking for it.  It's all part of a greater toolset for future projects.  People have really got to start looking at stories with positive sci-fi narratives regarding these technologies, because that's where you're gonna find your use cases.  I can imagine the technology saving motorcyclists using 4-point camera systems built into their helmets.

Hell, that right there could be one of the best use cases of all.  You can have AI-level eyes on the back of your head.  Right now.  If you've been mugged before, and that feeling of being snuck up on has never left the middle of your back, the technology is here today to give you 360 awareness without being in the US military.  

Personal safety alone is a phenomenal use case for this.

comments.author: @iczgighost
comments.text:
Hi Wes, I appreciate your enthusiasm for AI and your podcast. Assuming you are intellectually honest, I would challenge you and your listeners to ask AI the following sequence of prompts:
- Give me a ballpark estimate of the electric power consumed to respond to this prompt
- what is the power rating of a standard LED light bulb
- How much power does the human body typically consume in watts
- So, a single response to a complex prompt in AI may consume as much power as a human body does in 1-2 hours?
- what would be the estimated GHG emission from a single complex AI query?
- Given current technology, what is the total estimated carbon emissions coming from the AI build out initiative
- Is the selling point of the techno optimists promoting development of AGI that it will increase economic growth?
- Do these techno optimists understand the correlation between growth of GDP to growth of energy consumption, including the associated growth in global GHG emissions based on current technology?
- are the titans of the AI industry aware of the hypocrisy of their argument that the potential economic growth enabled by AGI will somehow solve climate change when in fact pursuing this path will likely make climate change and global GHG emissions worse?

I did this with Gemini 2.0 Flash experimental. It would be an awesome service to everyone if you would do this live on your podcast sometime. AI does see the problem with the techno optimist's arguments for pursuing AGI with the current unbridled enthusiasm. If you would like to get a little more well-rounded education about the energy-blind aspect of this type of techno-optimism, I would recommend checking out the The Great Simplification podcast by Nate Hagens and guests. I understand this may be threatening to your livelihood and strongly held beliefs. Like Upton Sinclair wrote, "It is difficult to get a man to understand something, when his salary depends upon his not understanding it."

This is in no way a put down of you personally. This is the human condition. We are all busy converting barrels of oil into microliters of dopamine running a bios that evolved in a very different available energy gradient. With deep respect,
